Video: Raksha Bandhan rush leaves Ghaziabad roads choked with long traffic jamsGhaziabad witnessed heavy traffic jams on Thursday evening, a day before Raksha Bandhan, as a surge in vehicles put major roads under pressure. Long queues were reported on the Delhi-Meerut Expressway, with videos from nearby high-rise residential societies showing vehicles backed up along the expressway. Traffic on NH-09 between Dasna and Mehrauli Cut also moved at a slow pace. One of the major bottlenecks was at the Delhi-Meerut Expressway exit, where the road narrows from eight lanes to two, creating heavy pressure as vehicles merge near the turn. Despite a traffic advisory issued ahead of the festival, the evening rush was further intensified by office-goers returning home and people travelling for Raksha Bandhan. Traffic was also affected at Lal Kuan, GT Road, Ambedkar Road and Meerut Tiraha. Traffic police teams were deployed across key routes, while diversions were implemented at some points.

PM Modi urges India to target more Olympic sports beyond its medal strengthsPrime Minister Narendra Modi has urged India to expand its Olympic footprint, saying the country misses out on a large share of medal events. He also called for greater focus on sports such as surfing and sport climbing.

Talent Hunt For 2036 Olympics Announced; Focus On Emerging Sports Ecosystem & Youth InfrastructureA major sports initiative was highlighted during the Khelo India Dialogue, emphasizing the need to expand success into emerging sports such as surfing, sports climbing, water sports, and winter sports by capitalizing on the nation's diverse geography and coastline. To build a robust sports ecosystem, district-level potential will be identified to foster specialized training environments. A key focus was placed on preparing athletes for the 2036 Olympics through a comprehensive talent hunt campaign targeting children aged five to fifteen, ensuring early identification based on physical fitness and interest. The government reaffirmed its commitment to establishing a modern twenty-first-century sports framework, featuring specialized universities, modern training centers, sports science, and international collaboration in coaching. Furthermore, the youth dialogue platform will integrate ideas, governance suggestions, and aspirations into national sports policy process. The program underscored the vital role of sportsperson spirit in instilling resilience, discipline, and healthy competition required for building a stronger nation.

2036 Olympics Prep, Talent Hunt For Ages 5-15 & Building Modern Sports Ecosystem FocusAt the Khelo India Dialogue, a vision for building a modern 21st-century sports ecosystem was outlined, placing special focus on preparing athletes for the 2036 Olympics. A talent hunt campaign targeting children aged 5 to 15 will identify and train young prospects based on fitness and interest. India seeks to tap into its coastline and mountain regions to excel in water, winter, and emerging sports such as surfing and sports climbing. The initiative emphasizes developing district-level sports ecosystems, sports universities, modern training facilities, and international collaboration in sports science and coaching. The platform integrates youth ideas on governance and sports development into the policy process. Sports are highlighted for instilling sportsmanship, resilience, and discipline, with para athletes serving as nationwide inspirations. Beyond competition, sports promote a healthy quality of life, lifestyle changes, and act as an effective deterrent against substance abuse among the youth.
